dresses.seoTitle: Boho & Summer Dresses for Women Online in India
dresses.seoDescription: Shop boho, floral and embroidered summer dresses for women — cotton, rayon & georgette in XS–2XL. Cash on delivery, 7-day returns, pan-India shipping.
dresses.intro: Breezy boho, floral and embroidered dresses in cotton, rayon and georgette — made for Indian summers, getaways and everything in between.
dresses.guideHtml:
What makes a great summer dress for Indian weather?

A great summer dress for Indian weather is made from a breathable natural fabric such as cotton, cotton slub or rayon, has a relaxed or fit-and-flare silhouette that lets air move, and uses detail — embroidery, crochet or tiers — instead of heavy layers to feel special.

How to choose your Trumee dress

By fabric

  • Cotton & cotton slub — the most breathable choice for hot, humid days; softens with every wash.
  • Rayon — fluid and cool against the skin, with a graceful drape for tiered and midi styles.
  • Georgette — lightweight and floaty; ideal for brunches, dinners and occasions.

By silhouette

  • Fit-and-flare and wrap dresses define the waist and flatter most body types.
  • Tiered midi dresses give movement and coverage — easy from day to evening.
  • Relaxed boho dresses skim the body for all-day comfort on travel days.

How to style a boho dress

Keep accessories natural: a woven or straw bag, flat sandals or white sneakers for day, and block heels or ankle boots when you want more polish. Add a denim shirt as a layer for air-conditioned evenings or cooler hill-station weather. Packing for a trip? Our vacation dresses are chosen to crush less and mix more.

Find your size

Our dresses run from XS to 2XL. Check the bust and waist measurements in our size chart; if you’re between sizes, size up for a relaxed fit.

Looking for a matching look? Explore our co-ord sets, vacation edit and crochet tops.

faqs.q: Which fabric is best for a summer dress in India?
faqs.a: Cotton and cotton slub are the most breathable for hot, humid weather. Rayon feels cool and drapes beautifully, while georgette is the lightest option for evenings and occasions.

faqs.q: What sizes are Trumee dresses available in?
faqs.a: Most Trumee dresses come in XS, S, M, L and XL, and many are also available in 2XL. Check the size chart on each product page — between sizes, we recommend sizing up.

faqs.q: Can I pay cash on delivery for dresses?
faqs.a: Yes. Cash on delivery is available across India, alongside UPI, cards, netbanking and wallets.

faqs.q: Can I return a dress if it doesn’t fit?
faqs.a: Yes — you can return unworn pieces with tags within 7 days of delivery. See our returns policy for details.

tops.seoTitle: Crochet & Boho Tops for Women Online in India
tops.seoDescription: Shop crochet lace, peplum, halter and embroidered boho tops for women. Breathable fabrics, sizes XS–XL, COD & 7-day returns across India.
tops.intro: Crochet-lace, peplum, halter and embroidered tops — the easy way to make jeans, skirts and shorts feel special.
tops.guideHtml:
What is a crochet top?

A crochet top is a top made with — or trimmed in — crochet lace, an openwork fabric formed from looped thread. Crochet adds texture and breathability, which is why crochet tops are a summer and vacation favourite, worn over a camisole or with a lining for coverage.

Trumee top styles, explained

  • Crochet-accent tops — crochet lace at the neckline, yoke or hem for a hand-finished boho look.
  • Peplum tops — a flared panel at the waist that defines the waistline and pairs well with straight jeans.
  • Halter & racerback tops — show a little shoulder; perfect for beach days and summer evenings.
  • Embroidered button-downs — polished enough for work, relaxed enough for the weekend.

How to style a crochet or boho top

Balance texture with simple bottoms: high-waisted denim, a flowy midi skirt or tailored trousers. For the office, layer a peplum or embroidered top under a blazer; for a getaway, pair a halter top with our embroidered skirts or shorts from our co-ord sets.

How to care for crochet lace

Hand wash in cold water, don’t wring, and dry flat in the shade so the lace keeps its shape.

faqs.q: How do you wash a crochet top?
faqs.a: Hand wash in cold water with a mild detergent, press out water without wringing, and dry flat in the shade. Avoid bleach and hot irons directly on the lace.

faqs.q: Are crochet tops see-through?
faqs.a: Open crochet can be sheer. Trumee tops use crochet as trims and panels on lined or solid bases, so most pieces can be worn without extra layering.

faqs.q: What should I wear with a peplum top?
faqs.a: Peplum tops look best with streamlined bottoms — straight or skinny jeans, cigarette trousers or a pencil skirt — so the flared waist stays the focus.

skirts.seoTitle: Embroidered Skirts for Women | Mini, Ruffle & Flared Skirts
skirts.seoDescription: Shop embroidered, ruffle-tiered and flared skirts for women in breathable cotton. Sizes XS–XL, COD available, easy 7-day returns across India.
skirts.intro: Embroidered, tiered and flared skirts in breathable cotton — let the skirt do the talking.
skirts.guideHtml:
Which skirt style suits you?

Flared and A-line skirts suit most body types because they skim the hips and define the waist. Ruffle-tiered skirts add volume and movement, while mini and wrap skirts show off the legs — pair any of them with a fitted top to keep the silhouette balanced.

Trumee skirts at a glance

  • Embroidered cotton flex skirts — statement thread-work on a comfortable, stretch-friendly base.
  • Ruffle-tiered skirts — Swiss-dot and printed cotton with bounce and swing.
  • Flared schiffli skirts — delicate lace details for brunches and day trips.
  • Utility skirts — dori embroidery with pockets and a waist tie.

How to style an embroidered skirt

Let the embroidery lead: pair with a plain tank, a crop top or a tucked-in shirt. Add sneakers for everyday, sandals for travel and heels for evenings. Browse our tops to complete the look.

faqs.q: What top goes with an embroidered skirt?
faqs.a: Choose a plain, fitted top — a camisole, crop top or solid shirt — so the embroidery stays the focal point.

faqs.q: Are Trumee skirts lined?
faqs.a: Lining varies by style; check the product description for details on each skirt.

jumpsuit.seoTitle: Cotton Jumpsuits for Women | Schiffli & Dungaree Jumpsuits
jumpsuit.seoDescription: Shop cotton schiffli jumpsuits and dungaree-style jumpsuits for women — scalloped hems, button straps, sizes XS–XL. COD & easy returns in India.
jumpsuit.intro: One-and-done cotton jumpsuits with schiffli embroidery, scalloped hems and button straps.
jumpsuit.guideHtml:
Why choose a cotton jumpsuit?

A cotton jumpsuit is a complete outfit in one piece: it breathes in the heat, needs no coordination, and looks put-together with nothing more than sandals and a bag — which makes it one of the easiest things to pack for travel or wear on a busy day.

How to style a jumpsuit

  • Day: white sneakers, a crossbody bag and sunglasses.
  • Evening: block heels, statement earrings and a belt to define the waist.
  • Layered: a denim shirt or crochet shrug over dungaree-style jumpsuits.

Finding your fit

Jumpsuits depend on torso length as well as bust and hips. Check the size chart, and WhatsApp us if you’d like advice before ordering.

faqs.q: What is schiffli embroidery?
faqs.a: Schiffli is a fine machine embroidery, often with eyelets and scalloped edges, stitched directly into the fabric. It gives cotton a delicate, lace-like finish.

faqs.q: How should a jumpsuit fit?
faqs.a: It should sit comfortably at the shoulders and waist with enough length in the torso to move freely; adjustable button straps help fine-tune the fit.

shirts.seoTitle: Women’s Shirts | Denim & Check Shirts with Embroidery
shirts.seoDescription: Shop women’s denim and check shirts with schiffli embroidery and roll-up sleeves. Wear solo or as a layer. COD & 7-day returns across India.
shirts.intro: Denim and check shirts with embroidered details — wear them buttoned, knotted or open as a layer.
shirts.guideHtml:
How to style an oversized shirt for women

Wear it three ways: buttoned and half-tucked into jeans, knotted at the waist over a skirt or dress, or open as a light layer over a camisole. Rolled sleeves and a relaxed fit keep it casual; tuck it fully into trousers for work.

Why a denim or check shirt earns its place

It’s the most versatile layer you can pack — it works over summer dresses on cool evenings, with skirts for brunch, and on its own with shorts.

faqs.q: Can I wear a shirt over a dress?
faqs.a: Yes — wear it open or knotted at the waist over a slip or sleeveless dress for an easy layered look.

co-ord-sets.seoTitle: Co-ord Sets for Women | Printed & Embroidered Co-ords
co-ord-sets.seoDescription: Shop printed and embroidered co-ord sets for women — shirt & shorts, shirt & pants. Mix, match or wear together. COD & easy returns in India.
co-ord-sets.intro: Matching sets you can wear together or split up — printed, embroidered and crochet-trimmed.
co-ord-sets.guideHtml:
What is a co-ord set?

A co-ord (coordinated) set is a matching top and bottom made from the same fabric or print — for example a shirt with shorts or pants. Worn together it looks like a complete outfit; worn separately, each piece pairs with basics already in your wardrobe.

Three ways to wear one co-ord

  1. Together — sneakers for day, sandals and a clutch for dinner.
  2. Shirt as a layer — open over a tank with jeans.
  3. Bottoms solo — with a plain tee or one of our crochet tops.

Heading away? Co-ords are travel heroes — see our vacation edit.

faqs.q: Can I buy the co-ord top and bottom separately?
faqs.a: Our co-ords are sold as sets so the print and fit match perfectly.

faqs.q: Are co-ord sets good for travel?
faqs.a: Very — one set gives you at least three outfits, so you can pack lighter.

escape-edit.seoTitle: Vacation Dresses & Holiday Outfits for Women | Nomadic Escapes
escape-edit.seoDescription: Beach and holiday outfits for women: breezy vacation dresses, crochet tops and co-ords for Goa, Gokarna and beyond. COD, 7-day returns, pan-India.
escape-edit.intro: Playful, easygoing silhouettes for the girl who travels light — beach days, road trips and barefoot evenings.
escape-edit.guideHtml:
What should you wear on a beach vacation in India?

For a beach holiday in India, pack breathable cotton or rayon dresses, a crochet or halter top with shorts, one co-ord set you can split into separate outfits, and a light shirt to layer in the evening. Stick to a small colour palette so every piece mixes and matches.

A 5-day holiday capsule

  • 2 summer dresses — one casual, one for dinners
  • 1 co-ord set — three outfits in one
  • 2 tops — a crochet top and a halter
  • 1 skirt and 1 pair of shorts
  • 1 denim or check shirt to layer

Packing tips

Roll, don’t fold, to avoid creases; choose prints that hide wrinkles; and keep embroidery and crochet on top of your bag so the detailing stays crisp.

faqs.q: What should I wear in Goa?
faqs.a: Light cotton or rayon dresses, crochet and halter tops with shorts, and a co-ord set for day-to-night. Add a light shirt for breezy evenings and comfortable sandals.

faqs.q: How many outfits should I pack for a 5-day trip?
faqs.a: About eight to ten pieces that mix and match — two dresses, a co-ord set, two tops, a skirt, shorts and a layering shirt cover most plans.

faqs.q: How fast will my vacation order arrive?
faqs.a: Orders ship in 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 2–4 business days in metro cities and 3–6 in other cities. Use the delivery checker on any product page to see dates for your pincode.

in-her-element.seoTitle: Office Wear for Women | Western Office Casuals — Nine to Thrive
in-her-element.seoDescription: Sleek western office casuals for women: embroidered shirts, peplum tops and midi dresses that go from boardroom to after-hours. COD & easy returns.
in-her-element.intro: Sleek, confident pieces that flow from boardroom to after-hours.
in-her-element.guideHtml:
What are office casuals for women?

Office casuals are polished but relaxed outfits — think embroidered shirts, peplum or button-down tops with tailored trousers, and knee-to-midi dresses — that look professional in a meeting yet comfortable enough for a full day and after-work plans.

Build a work-week with Nine to Thrive

  • Monday: embroidered button-down + straight trousers
  • Wednesday: midi dress + blazer
  • Friday: peplum top + dark denim, straight to dinner

Pair with our shirts and tops for more combinations.

faqs.q: Can boho pieces work for the office?
faqs.a: Yes — choose subtle embroidery, midi lengths and structured layers like a blazer or shirt to keep a boho piece office-appropriate.

after-the-rain.seoTitle: Monsoon Outfits for Women | After the Rain Edit
after-the-rain.seoDescription: Romantic, breezy monsoon outfits for women — quick-dry rayon, cotton dresses and tops in moody prints. COD & 7-day returns across India.
after-the-rain.intro: Romantic, breezy styles inspired by earthy rains and mood-lit skies.
after-the-rain.guideHtml:
What to wear in the monsoon

In the monsoon, choose light fabrics that dry quickly such as rayon and thin cotton, knee-length or shorter hemlines that stay clear of puddles, darker or printed colours that hide splashes, and closed or waterproof footwear.

Monsoon styling notes

  • Midi and mini dresses over long flowy hems
  • Prints and deep tones — plum, rust, navy
  • A light shirt instead of heavy jackets

More ideas in our dresses and style journal.

faqs.q: Which fabrics are best for the monsoon?
faqs.a: Rayon and lightweight cotton dry faster than heavy fabrics. Avoid thick denim and long trailing hems on rainy days.

free-spirited.seoTitle: Bohemian Clothing for Women | Free Spirited Boho Edit
free-spirited.seoDescription: Flowy silhouettes, earthy prints and crochet details — bohemian clothing for women who don’t follow a plan. COD & easy returns across India.
free-spirited.intro: Flowy silhouettes, earthy prints, and that carefree energy — made for days that don’t follow a plan.
free-spirited.guideHtml:
What is bohemian style?

Bohemian (boho) style is a relaxed, free-spirited way of dressing built on flowy silhouettes, earthy and floral prints, natural fabrics and handcrafted details such as crochet, embroidery and tassels — layered and accessorised with a lived-in, effortless feel.

How to get the boho look

  • Start with one flowy piece — a tiered dress or ruffle skirt
  • Add texture: crochet lace, embroidery or tassels
  • Finish with natural accessories: straw, wood, silver

Shop boho dresses, crochet tops and skirts.

faqs.q: What is the difference between boho and bohemian?
faqs.a: They’re the same — “boho” is simply the short form of bohemian style.

wander-x-wear.seoTitle: Travel Outfits for Women | Wander x Wear
wander-x-wear.seoDescription: Comfortable, crease-friendly travel outfits for women — dresses, co-ords and tops for every detour, daydream and destination. COD & easy returns.
wander-x-wear.intro: Outfits for every detour, daydream, and destination.
wander-x-wear.guideHtml:
What makes a good travel outfit?

A good travel outfit is comfortable for long hours, made from breathable fabric that resists visible creasing, easy to layer for changing temperatures, and versatile enough to go from sightseeing to dinner with a quick change of shoes or accessories.

Travel-day formula

A co-ord set or relaxed dress + white sneakers + a shirt to layer + a crossbody bag. See our vacation edit for beach trips.

faqs.q: Which fabrics wrinkle the least when travelling?
faqs.a: Rayon, georgette and printed cottons show fewer creases than plain linens; rolling clothes instead of folding helps too.

main-character-energy.seoTitle: Trendy Outfits for Women | Moodboard Essentials
main-character-energy.seoDescription: Youthful, bold, digital-era fashion for women — trendy dresses, tops and co-ords for the unapologetic dresser. COD & 7-day returns across India.
main-character-energy.intro: Youthful, bold, digital-era fashion for the unapologetic dresser.
main-character-energy.guideHtml:
What are the key trends for 2026?

Heading into 2026, craft-led details — crochet, embroidery and lace — remain strong, alongside playful prints, ruffles and tiers, and easy matching sets. The common thread is personality: pieces that photograph well but still feel comfortable enough for everyday wear.

Build your moodboard with our dresses, co-ord sets and tops.
